description: Table-driven exact conversion tests cover localized ungrouped decimal input, whitespace, null/blank, zero, USD two digits, JPY zero digits, BHD three digits, and each currency's maximum-safe value.
verification: taxCapForm.test.ts: exact USD/JPY/BHD and locale conversion.

description: Reject negatives including -0, excess fraction digits including trailing zeros, grouping/mixed separators, exponent/hex notation, symbols, embedded whitespace, malformed suffixes, NaN/Infinity, and one minor unit above MAX_SAFE_INTEGER without rounding.
verification: taxCapForm.test.ts plus rendered TaxRates invalid-input matrix.

description: Round-trip maximum-safe minor amounts through edit text and currency-coded list/detail formatting in dot- and comma-decimal locales without losing a final digit.
verification: taxCapForm.test.ts: maximum-safe dot/comma edit and display; TaxCapFields exact hydration.

description: Strict cap normalization accepts PostgreSQL digit strings and safe numbers including zero; rejects unsafe, fractional numeric strings that Number would round, booleans, malformed notation, non-finite values, and negative values.
verification: taxCapInvoiceCompute.test.ts: strict numeric/string/boolean boundaries.

description: Rendered add/edit form tests prove blank submits null, zero submits 0, stored bigint-derived values hydrate exactly, cancel/reopen resets state, failed saves retain text, and duplicate save clicks produce one request.
verification: TaxRates.test.tsx: rendered real screen/action payloads, reopen, cancellation, failure, duplicate submission.

description: Rendered edit tests assert an untouched cap/currency pair is omitted, formatting-only changes are not dirty, changing then clearing sends null, zero is distinct from blank, and ordinary field changes preserve the cap.
verification: TaxRates.test.tsx and taxCapForm.test.ts: canonical dirty checks and omitted/null/zero payloads.

description: Currency interaction tests require a code for a new cap including zero, preserve an existing code, refuse silent reinterpretation on currency change, show applicability guidance, and keep the code when clearing the cap.
verification: TaxCapFields.test.tsx, TaxRates.test.tsx and taxCapForm.test.ts: currency selection, reentry and clear.

description: Legacy capped-universal form tests cover nonzero and zero: show exact raw minor units rather than No cap, preserve on unrelated save, require explicit resolution with a monetary preview, and allow clear without selecting currency.
verification: TaxCapFields.test.tsx: both legacy zero and 500, explicit resolution; form/actions preserve/clear tests.

description: Validation tests use actual field events to produce each localized error class, assert no action call on invalid input, associate labels/help/errors, and focus the invalid cap or currency control.
verification: TaxRates.test.tsx: localized error keys and invalid-control focus; live USD precision feedback.

description: Schema matrix covers create/update/response/advanced shapes, safe integer maximum, zero, null, omitted properties, currency codes, string/fractional/unsafe input rejection, and normalized PostgreSQL response values; no partial-update default may add a missing cap.
verification: taxRateSchemas.test.ts and migrated-DB GET response normalization tests.

description: DB-backed action lifecycle on migrated schema creates a capped explicit-currency rate, reads the normalized response, updates its amount, preserves it on omitted update, clears to SQL NULL, sets numeric zero, and verifies each persisted row.
verification: taxRateCaps.db.test.ts: action lifecycle and SQL bigint/null assertions.

description: DB-backed action guard matrix rejects invalid caps/currencies and attempts to unset currency while retaining a cap, accepts simultaneous clear, confirms no mutation after rejection, and verifies the parent negative-cap database constraint.
verification: taxRateCaps.db.test.ts: action rejection and actual PostgreSQL check constraint/savepoint.

description: DB-backed legacy-pair tests preserve existing universal caps on omitted and identical explicit payloads, allow clear and explicit currency resolution, reject a changed cap without currency, and prove tenant-default-currency changes do not reinterpret explicit caps.
verification: taxRateCaps.db.test.ts: legacy pair rules and unchanged GBP cap after tenant base currency change.

description: Authorization and tenant tests run real action queries for billing-read-only, missing create/update/read, unauthenticated, product-restricted, and cross-tenant requests; forged tenant fields and foreign rate IDs must not expose or mutate caps.
verification: taxRateCaps.db.test.ts: controlled auth/permission boundaries with real tenant queries; live dedicated billing-read-only user. Authentication itself remains the existing shared wrapper.

description: Tax-rates GET integration proves the body contains rate IDs and normalized cap/currency values rather than transactions; exercise pagination/filters, zero/null/legacy/max-safe responses, authentication, API/billing permissions, product access, and tenant isolation.
verification: taxRateCaps.db.test.ts: real GET handler/controller/service/SQL and pagination with controlled authentication boundary, 401/403 and scoped response matrix.

description: Rendered list/detail/composite tests show No cap, explicit-currency zero/amount, and unresolved legacy values; composite help states that regional contributions use the cap while component totals do not; no project/per-component controls are introduced.
verification: TaxCapFields.test.tsx: actual shared list/detail readout and composite messages; live read-only detail navigation.

description: Invoice integration creates/updates a cap through the same action contract used by the UI and generates real migrated-DB draft invoices through the manual flow: 100.00 at 10% produces 5.00, then 3.00, then 10.00 after clear, then 0.00 after zero.
verification: Executed headed browser automation through actual manual UI and persisted drafts, backed by read-only SQL verification; see VALIDATION.md. The durable checked-in DB regression additionally exercises the same action-to-tax contract.

description: Automated-billing integration loads the persisted cap into the compute context and generates a draft through that path, comparing previews and persisted tax; test an explicit non-default invoice currency, a cap binding at 5.00, clear, and zero without substituting a mocked calculator.
verification: taxRateCaps.db.test.ts: real recurring previewInvoice + generateInvoice + persisted header/charge assertions, GBP contract vs USD client default, 500/null/zero. Only auth/analytics boundaries mocked.

description: Shared regional-calculator parity tests compare the parent and preloaded paths for binding and nonbinding caps, multiple rate contributions, zero, and the parent 325 at 1.1% plus 2.9% uncapped rounding regression.
verification: taxCapInvoiceCompute.test.ts: shared parent/preloaded regional parity, binding caps and uncapped rounding.

description: Retain and run parent default/simple/progressive/regional/period suites: per-rate and per-segment caps, exempt/reverse-charge behavior, coverage gaps, exact arithmetic, and unchanged uncapped outputs; separately assert composite default totals remain uncapped while regional row contributions cap.
verification: Parent calculateTax, calculateTaxForPeriod, thresholdsAndComposite and rateSelection suites passed.

description: Currency-selection integration proves matching explicit-currency rates apply, other currencies do not select them under existing default/regional rules, universal uncapped rates remain unchanged, and 0-/3-digit values reach tax in the intended minor units.
verification: taxRateCaps.db.test.ts: JPY/BHD form units through persisted rate and TaxService; parent default/regional selection matrix.

description: Keyboard and viewport smoke exercises Tab/Enter/Escape, focus restoration, helper disclosure, Clear tax cap, sticky footer, 360px/desktop layouts, light/dark themes, long translations, and read-only row/detail behavior.
verification: Headed live 360px/desktop light/dark, pseudo yy, keyboard/clear/disclosure, read-only and focus-restoration retests; see evidence directory.

description: Locale/documentation contract checks cover all new keys in en/de/es/fr/it/nl/pl/pt/xx/yy, parameter parity, localized server errors, API minor-unit/null examples, no-UI statement removal, and accurate currency/composite/project distinctions.
verification: All ten locale namespaces and parameter parity validated; configuration/API/calculation documents reviewed.

description: Verify migrated CE and EE schemas have the inherited currency_code and cap_amount columns/constraint and can execute rate create/read/update; do not use source-only checks as schema evidence.
verification: Actual migrated PostgreSQL columns/constraint/action tests passed under separate community and EE environment processes, using the same shared migrated test_database. Independent CE/EE stack deployments were not run.

description: Live smoke uses real Tax Rates controls to set 5.00, edit 3.00, clear, and set zero, reloads/reopens each state, and captures fresh draft totals 5.00/3.00/10.00/0.00 on a 100.00 taxable amount at 10%, plus read-only denial and a second calculation proving the cap is not invoice-wide; no direct DB cap writes.
verification: Headed actual Tax Rates/invoice UI: set/edit/clear/zero, reload/reopen, read-only, and distinct-region invoice tax 10.00 with two 5.00 caps. No direct DB cap writes. See VALIDATION.md.
